response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS n FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.dealedge IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.dealedge), a AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS av FROM c) SELECT SUM(c.n) AS total_count, AVG(c.n - a.av) AS avg_excess FROM c, a WHERE c.n > a.av

assumptions.assumption: Each order is counted once per side, even if several risk/margin records match it (COUNT DISTINCT recordvault).
Orders with a NULL dealedge are not a side and are excluded from the average across sides.
The average across sides is a simple average of the per-side counts, over sides that have at least one matched order.

alternatives.interpretation: Count matched risk/margin records (join rows) per side, so an order with several risk/margin records is counted several times.
alternatives.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.dealedge IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.dealedge), a AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS av FROM c) SELECT SUM(c.n) AS total_count, AVG(c.n - a.av) AS avg_excess FROM c, a WHERE c.n > a.av
